gate_1_free_box.claim: one MRS body coupled through a grid with no wall is the body uncoupled: the handed 6x6 is the free-space MRS's own, with Hasimoto's term for the grid box's images in the steady limit
gate_1_free_box.case: tests/flow/test_schwarz_free_box.py::test_one_body_coupled_through_a_grid_with_no_wall_is_the_body_uncoupled (IMEX through the flow's own CG on a box with no wall; steady through a free periodic box as the grid)

prediction.unit: the largest entry of the 6x6's difference, each row and column scaled by the square root of its diagonal
prediction.why: the free box removes the body's own discretised field exactly (one lattice, one kernel); what is left are the boxes' images: screened under the inertial step (their irrotational part about 6 pi nu dt a / L^3 of the self term, 2e-4), Hasimoto's next term 4.19 (a/L)^3 (1e-3) in the steady limit

control.resolution: 1.6e-2 under the inertial step against a line of 1e-3 (16 times); of the order of the 6x6 in the steady limit

gate_1_free_box.if_wrong: a clean miss above the line is the box's alignment with the grid's lattice or the image term's
gate_1_free_box.cannot_discriminate_if: the grid's own response of the body is below the line (a very screened step): r = nu dt / h^2 = 0.1 here keeps it at 1.6e-2

gate_3_monolithic.claim: the Schwarz step (seven columns by GMRES with the walled CG in each product, the body stepping through the handed response, the composition) is the monolithic step (one dense LU of the field's every face, the tractions and the twist) within the solves' line
gate_3_monolithic.case: tests/flow/test_schwarz_step.py::test_the_schwarz_step_is_the_monolithic_step (functions, IMEX and steady) and tests/flow/test_schwarz_flow.py::test_the_flow_node_steps_as_the_monolithic_step (the node's initial preparation and first step)

prediction.unit: relative (field, tractions, twist, the body's wrench)
prediction.why: every unknown is a linear function of solves stopped at their tolerances (GMRES 1e-10, CG 1e-12); the steady limit's conditioning is the near field's, a few times IMEX's

gate_3_monolithic.metric: the largest relative difference over the field, the tractions, the twist and the wrench

control.plant: GMRES capped at one product (restart 1, cap 1); the composition dropped (the field left at its base); the composition read at the body's live pose
control.environment_variable: MIME_PLANT_SCHWARZ: cap (GMRES capped at one product), drop (the composition dropped), live (the composition read at the body's live pose)
control.resolution: each plant moves the compared unknowns by 4e-6 or more against a line of 1e-7 [measured-before]

gate_3_monolithic.if_wrong: a clean miss is the scheme's or the reference's defect: compare a product's reflection with the reference's Jacobian columns
gate_3_monolithic.cannot_discriminate_if: the body's force did not reach the field (no cross term): the body's twist and the drive are nonzero and the composition moves the field by orders above the line

gate_6_frozen.claim: the step is composed at the pose its columns were prepared at, and the next step prepared at the pose the body reached
gate_6_frozen.case: tests/flow/test_schwarz_flow.py::test_the_flow_node_steps_as_the_monolithic_step (the prepared pose recorded and equal to the body's) and its live-pose control

prediction.unit: the prepared pose's difference from the body's pose, m
prediction.why: the pose is stored state, written once a step

gate_6_frozen.metric: the stored pose against the body's, and the field against the monolithic step's

control.plant: the composition read at the body's live pose
control.resolution: a move of dt V' moves the field by 4e-6 against a line of 1e-7, and flags the composed residual

gate_6_frozen.if_wrong: a frozen value read live is what the 0.2 line's moving targets were
gate_6_frozen.cannot_discriminate_if: the body does not move within the step: its twist is drawn nonzero

gate_9_definiteness.claim: the handed 6x6's margin is reported each step, and an indefinite one stops the run by name (flow.schwarz-indefinite)

prediction.unit: the scaled least eigenvalue of the handed 6x6 at the gates' poses
prediction.why: a sphere off the wall by cells: the free-space MRS's own resistance dominates

gate_9_definiteness.metric: schwarz_0_margin; the stop and its code
gate_9_definiteness.if_wrong: a positive margin read indefinite would be the scaling's (a zero diagonal reads NaN)
gate_9_definiteness.cannot_discriminate_if: the margin is NaN in both arms
